scope: D03 implementation and local source-fixture verification only

checks.notes: Pure native API receipt checks: exact age/DCQL and authenticated names, extra disclosure rejection, issuer and tenant binding, explicit issuer-specific trust rejection with unknown typed backend reason, exact ownership and pending-offer cleanup. Final15-case rerun includes generic invalid_presentation/presentation failed and verifier-trust rejection refusal. The final pending-cancellation transport change leaves native planning behavior unchanged; only its receipt scope wording and test name changed after this 15-case run. The controller integration was rerun and the CLI rebuilt.

Authenticated fact fixtures pass through the real HTTP policy evaluation. Additional disclosure remains visible by name without value leakage; unauthenticated and ambiguous mappings never publish an inventory. Existing ten-operation HTTP behavior case also passes.
Two existing language-neutral contracts and two names-only mdoc projection checks. Pinned dependency download required ordinary authorized network access.
Includes configured internal DID resolution and denial of ambient DID-web egress. A temporary localhost-only fixture required authorized socket permission; no beta request.
Rebuilt and executed after the final cleanup receipt wording update; version check is not an additional named test.

Controlled browser/API adapters exercise dependency read failure, canonical mutation-ID retention, lost responses, exact cleanup only, known rejection, Rust cleanup refusal and explicit refusal to turn generic rejection diagnostics into the issuer-trust assertion. The new pending cleanup regression uses the real shared cancellation helper through controlled page transport: an expired captured transaction is cancelled only after exact revoked readback; an HTTP-success response with unconfirmed readback keeps transaction-scoped uncertainty and cleanup incomplete. No network or browser launched.
Real React components with controlled service fixtures: authenticated names/trust display, exact terminal-result fetch, foreign/unavailable result rejection and stale-result closure.

Config contract, all frozen controls before issuance, empty-wallet observation and distinct selection, exact runtime request destinations, blocked tool/lane gates, restoration after a lost recording response, and unchanged shared two-lane gate with synthetic unit-test media. Final check also refuses generic presentation rejection and verifier trust messages during control preflight, before issuance.

dataChecks: git diff --check passed in both repositories.
Dedicated recorder configuration passes existing validateConfig in the focused adapter test.
Only D03-related changed and new Rust files were formatted with rustfmt.

D03 readStackManifest binding passes against the current production-gaps draft with revision2 and [openid4vci-1.0,openid4vp-1.0,dcql-1.0]. assertionCoverage reports COMPLETE: exactly four catalog contractId mappings, no missing or unknown declarations. Both wallet gates remain mandatory outside the catalog assertion set.
limitations: No live beta request, issuance, native wallet execution, deployment, publication or rendered guided master was performed.
Frozen source-specific EUDI and SpruceID profiles/APKs/AVD snapshots/control fixtures and active managed mDL/policy/trust resources are still required. Placeholders fail before issuance.

Actual issuer-signature, trust and holder authentication remains the existing native mdoc verifier responsibility. The new Rust CLI validates measured public replies and never grants independent-wallet qualification.
The signed native request is fetched over bound HTTPS and structurally inspected/bound; the CLI does not independently verify its request-object signature.

A successful negative observation is ISSUER_TRUST_REJECTION_OBSERVED with issuer_trust_denial_observed=true only when the pinned wallet explicitly identifies the issuer as untrusted or not trusted. Generic invalid_presentation, presentation failed, verifier-trust, unknown and pending messages cannot pass. backend_reason_code remains null; no typed native backend reason is inferred.
Issuance is explicit API fixture setup; holder consent and result inspection use actual wallet and administrator UI paths. No governed applicant UI or camera scan is claimed.

Only current-run resources can be cleaned. Exact captured unredeemed transactions now use the shared authenticated cancellation helper, including after natural expiry. Lost creation IDs, an issued-record race, ownership refusal or unconfirmed revoked readback keep cleanup incomplete; uncertain cancellation mutations retain their transaction IDs.
Android emulator recordings do not prove physical-device security. Both independent lanes, real media and privacy scans remain mandatory.

Draft transcript timings, voice choice, crops, pointers and source/report/secondary media hashes remain unbound until a real capture is inspected. The shared lifecycle-v1 profile does not grant human approval.
initialAttemptNotes: Offline cache was missing public lockfile-pinned crates. Ordinary sandbox network retry could not reach its proxy; authorized require_escalated retry downloaded dependencies without changing Cargo.lock.

The issuer resolver localhost fixture initially failed with PermissionDenied in the restricted sandbox (4 passed, 1 environment failure). The identical command with authorized localhost permission passed all 5.

Node --test in this host reported the controller file as one aggregate. Direct node execution reported all 6 initial named cases (7 after the final denial regression and 8 after pending-cancellation integration); direct commands are retained above for both new Node test files.
An initial recorder test used an incorrect functional.supported property. It was corrected to the existing functionalRerunUnsupportedReason contract before the passing 7-case run.

Final review tightened the earlier generic rejected-fixture observation into an explicit issuer-specific trust observation. The15-case Rust validator suite,7-case driver suite and7-case recorder adapter suite were rerun and passed; CLI rebuilt.

The final pending-offer correction reused cancelOwnedIssuanceTransaction without editing the shared helper. The D03 controller suite passed 8 cases; native planning logic is unchanged, and only the receipt wording/test name changed. No broad Rust rerun was performed; the current CLI version build passed.
